historical_record.description: Listed on the National Register of Historic Places as the Baker & Hamilton warehouse.
Built as the Baker & Hamilton warehouse, a heavy timber-framed brick building that became the model for several later warehouses in the district. Designed by Sutton & Weeks.

historic_survey.status_code_meaning: California Historical Resource Status Codes: a 1 or 2 means listed or formally determined eligible, a 3 means the survey judged it eligible, a 5 means locally significant, a 6 that it was found ineligible, and a 7 that it was not evaluated.
